title: Connection to masonry fireplace flue.
officialText:
A connector shall extend from the appliance to the flue serving a masonry
fireplace such that the flue gases are exhausted directly into the flue. The connector shall be accessible or removable for inspection
and cleaning of both the connector and the flue. Listed direct connection devices shall be installed in accordance with their listing.
